# For Whom to Produce

<!-- STEP id="buyers" -->
A shoe maker must ask: who will wear these shoes? People have different needs, incomes and tastes. Students, office workers, players and families all need shoes, but not the same shoes.

<!-- STEP id="shoes" -->
School shoes are simple, strong and cheap. Office shoes look formal and often use leather. Sports shoes have rubber soles that grip and bend. Slippers are comfortable and cheap.

**The answer to 'for whom' decides the design and the material.**
